text: APPROVE. The extracted `IsFirstPartySource` keeps the same checks in the same order, and `IsFirstPartySource(file, root) && --count == 0` short-circuits so `count` is decremented only for first-party files, as before; the three nested `if`/`continue` branches are gone from `AtLeast`, which should drop its complexity well below 15, and the new private static helper uses only members and variables that were already in scope, so it should build without new warnings.
